summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) – IndianOil group
intro: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL), a group company of IndianOil, has released Advertisement No. 02 of 2026 for 41 Executive posts – Engineers in Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil and Instrumentation disciplines, plus Officer (Information Systems), Junior Officer (Official Language) and Manager/Senior Manager (Secretarial).
Online applications opened on 4 November 2026 and close on 3 December 2026. This recruitment also appeared in Employment News (28 Nov – 4 Dec 2026).
table: Engineering degree in relevant discipline (most posts) / post-specific – see official notification

after: Grade-wise and category-wise split is given in the official advertisement.

p: Most engineering posts need a full-time engineering degree in the relevant discipline (reported as first class with at least 60% marks), and some posts need post-qualification experience. Non-engineering posts have their own qualifications. Check the post-wise table in the official notice.
Age limit (post-wise), relaxation and fee are given in the official advertisement on cpcl.co.in. We will update this page once confirmed.

ol: Read the notification and check your eligibility.
Register and fill the online form.
Upload documents, pay the fee (if applicable) and submit by 3 December 2026.

CPCL (Advt 02/2026) is recruiting 41 Executives: Chemical Engineering 22, Mechanical 7, Electrical 5, Civil 2, Instrumentation 1, plus Officer (IS), Junior Officer (OL) and Manager/Senior Manager (Secretarial).

Eligibility: Engineering degree in the relevant discipline for engineering posts; post-specific for others.

Dates: Apply online 4 November – 3 December 2026 at cpcl.co.in.
